games.description: Game ids from the app catalog that the user plays.

badges.description: Badges the user has earned. Once earned, a badge stays earned.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name used to compute daily resets for this user.

createdAt.description: When this profile record was first created.

favorites.description: Game ids that the user has favorited. Shown in a dedicated group on the home page.

displayName.description: Optional override of the user's Bluesky display name for this app.

displayOrder.description: Optional user-preferred ordering of game ids.

main.description: A user's daily-games profile. Singleton per repo (rkey = 'self').

id.description: Badge id. Known values cover the app's published badge catalog; unknown values are accepted for forward compatibility.

category.description: Grouping used by the app UI.

earnedAt.description: When the badge was first earned (date of earliest play that satisfied the criteria).

badge.description: A user accomplishment. `id` is a stable identifier from the app's badge catalog; `earnedAt` is the date the user first met the criteria.
